submission.justification: Based on available candidate specifications, simulation results, and safety criteria, Absorber-F1 with a 5 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution at 100 GeV while keeping the residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown below the 20 uSv/h safety threshold. This plate thickness is within the allowed range (2-10 mm). Therefore, this configuration meets all constraints and the project goal.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 is explicitly listed among the approved candidate materials.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: Simulation and documentation confirm that Absorber-F1, 5 mm, produces a dose rate below the 20 uSv/h limit.
Selected thickness is 5 mm, which is within the permitted 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Recommendation consists of one material (Absorber-F1) and one plate thickness (5 mm).
